subject.title: fix(tools): surface empty availability group diagnostics via onHiddenDiagnostic callback

question: Should maintainers accept this PR as the canonical warn-only implementation for plugin tool availability authoring diagnostics?
rationale: The code is plausible and currently has no blocking finding, but it changes plugin descriptor metadata observability and competes with open sibling implementations for the same issue, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Accept this canonical warn-only PR
options.body: Land this PR after final maintainer review, then close or supersede the overlapping sibling PRs because this patch keeps the evaluator pure and includes plugin registration coverage.

options.title: Choose a narrower sibling instead
options.body: Use one of the smaller open alternatives if maintainers prefer less plugin resolver surface, and close this PR as superseded with a link to the selected implementation.

options.title: Request more live plugin proof
options.body: Ask for a live external plugin package startup proof if the current terminal `resolvePluginTools` proof is not enough to accept the compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept this canonical warn-only PR
recommendation.body: Land this PR after final maintainer review, then close or supersede the overlapping sibling PRs because this patch keeps the evaluator pure and includes plugin registration coverage.
